title: The Pale Stag
subtitle: A kill task that names its quarry
description: The valley's white wolf has been called a stag so long that the
calendar has given up correcting anybody. This is what a
`customName` filter is for: the kill task names
`minecraft:wolf` and, beside it, the name the nametag says -- and
only a wolf carrying that exact name counts.
A name is the one thing an entity id cannot reach. The field
exists because the calendar kept getting filed under 'wolf'.
